behavior: A new account gets one welcome email at its verified login email
acceptance: When POST /v1/me creates a user that has a verified login email, the worker sends one welcome email to that address through the outbox: once per account, also across retries and a worker restart, with a stable Idempotency-Key
No welcome email when the account has no login email, and none for accounts that existed before this change; the profile email setting does not turn it off (it is about the account, not an invoice)
The email says what Forwend does in two or three plain sentences and links to /app; tests use the fake sender
notes: 2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Pass. Ran: go test ./internal/... all ok; go test -tags e2e ./e2e/ ok, TestExceptionsCancelAndEmail still sees exactly 6 emails with unchanged invoice keys forwend-<0x invoice>-<event>-<hash> (e2e seeds its user directly, welcome=false). Once per account: UPDATE ... WHERE login_email IS NULL plus unique index; scratch test with 4 parallel POST /v1/me per new user x15 (31 Privy reads) gave exactly 15 welcome rows, 15 users. Existing accounts: column default false, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING keeps it. Address only from Privy via login_email, set once. Subject check rejects welcome without user and invoice rows with user_id; deleting a user cascades its welcome row (profiles FK still blocks deleting users with profiles, unchanged). Bell query inner-joins invoices so welcome rows never show (events 200, empty); payer_email.go filters by invoice_id+kind. deliverOne refactor: invoice key, skip rule, receipt routing unchanged; only error text moved from 'read email event N invoice:' to 'read email event N: invoice:' (cosmetic). Mutations in scratch copy: dropping the welcome flag, the non-empty check, the welcome=true insert, applying the profile setting, changing the welcome key scope, changing invoice key scope, sending to another column were all caught. Survivors (not defects): removing ON CONFLICT (UPDATE guard already holds) and dropping the address hash from the welcome key (login_email never changes). Copy nit: 'Create an invoice' while a new Personal profile's UI says 'Request money'; otherwise matches PROJECT.md (stablecoins to your wallet; paid/settled/held emails; per-profile off).
